نختتن (form VIII)

# نُخْتَتَنُ (nuḵtatanu) /nux.ta.ta.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# نَخْتَتِنَ (naḵtatina) /nax.ta.ti.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# نُخْتَتَنَ (nuḵtatana) /nux.ta.ta.na/:
